core_obligations: Reduce to the prestable family via the tail contraction

difficulty_reason: Semistability criterion in the prestable family: after the prestable reduction the contraction c : X -> Y contracting rational tails has Y a family of curves, and (non)existence of rational tails is read off fibrewise from deg(c_*omega_X) versus deg(omega_Y); the two directions are the contraction lemma and the degree computation on the contracted components. Retained author proof at lines 2386-2472.

compared.note: Semistable locus criterion; distinct from lemma-stable (adds genus and k = H^0 conditions).
